correctness.rationale: All idempotent endomorphisms induce a degree-one projection, and unipotent conjugation sends them to its homogeneous free-algebra extension. The identity-linear automorphism group has q^{n(n²+n³)} elements; exact centralizers and free-subalgebra stabilizers give the image, fiber, and rank formulas. Gaussian binomial ratios are uniformly bounded; the leading quartic exponent has a unique strictly concave maximum alpha and produces two-point exponential concentration. Computations in verify.py confirm exhaustive generator-one examples and the complete quadratic-to-cubic fixed-projection fiber over F3, without replacing the general proof.

value.rationale: Retractions are natural split subalgebra structures. The claim counts all their embedded images and operator fibers for every odd finite field and arbitrary generator number, and yields a nontrivial irrational limiting generator-rank fraction and exponential two-point condensation. The degree-three term changes the exponent structure relative to previously studied quadratic free algebras, making the result a motivated structural classification rather than a routine substitution.
